description: GPU shared memory access patterns for bank conflict analysis. Each pattern specifies byte offsets accessed by 32 threads (t=0..31) in a single warp.
note: For formula-based patterns, 't' is the thread index (0-31). Evaluate the Python integer expression for each t to get the byte offset.

all_same_bank.description: Column 0 access of a row-major float[32][32] matrix (stride 128 bytes)

stride_6.description: Strided access with stride of 6 float elements (24 bytes per step)

pure_broadcast.description: All 32 threads read from the same byte address

mixed_broadcast_conflict.description: Groups of threads share addresses across banks, creating both broadcasts within groups and conflicts between groups that map to the same bank

quadratic_scatter.description: Non-linear scatter pattern using quadratic index mapping with modular arithmetic
